visualReference.observation: The photographed board has three rows, pieces and marked squares near the end of the path. The museum records that the missing tiles and wood are modern restoration. Keep the whole board legible and attach a path arrow only to verified board coordinates.

recorderRights.scope: The uploader offers the gameplay recording for reuse with attribution. Nintendo's policy covers creative commentary separately. Do not represent the game as CC-licensed. Exclude original audio and include the recording attribution, source URL and edit description in KO/EN descriptions.

video.acquisition: Single format downloaded directly with no audio, merge, transcode, resize or frame-rate conversion. The video packet payload matches the older archive. Preserve the inset retro aspect ratio and entire playfield.

gameplaySource.fhdEvidence: The uploader describes the footage as HD gameplay and the direct published 1080p stream was verified through actual frame decoding. The pre-upload capture chain is undocumented. Keep that separate from the source-format and decode proof.

gameplaySource.limits: Cue spans describe directly inspected frame samples, not locked cuts or a continuous playback check. Preserve the display geometry and native speed. Verify remaining game examples, playable event boundaries and the episode's footage ratio before locking narration.

authoredComparison.finding: Across 601 shared states the tracking view first sees part of the second hazard at tick 271 and all of it at tick 288. It remains outside the fixed view. The avatar leaves the fixed view at tick 368. These are geometric observations of the authored traversal, with no reaction-time claim.
